description: Causal estimator-context feature vectors for all 885 VLM-eligible observations. Every feature is available at decision time. No future frames, no GT poses.
causal_guarantees: world_displacement_at_obs uses only SLAM poses up to the observation timestamp.
No ground-truth trajectory poses enter any feature.
Trajectory role is ESTIMATED throughout (enforced by unified_pipeline.py).
No feature looks ahead in time beyond the current observation frame.

detection_confidence.description: YOLO detection confidence score for this observation.

crop_area_px.description: Pixel area of the detected bounding box.

sharpness.description: Laplacian variance of the crop — higher = sharper.

has_mask.description: Whether a YOLO-seg mask was produced for this observation.

median_depth_m.description: Median depth within the bounding box (metres).

centroid_world_x.description: World-frame centroid X at observation time.

centroid_world_y.description: World-frame centroid Y at observation time.

centroid_world_z.description: World-frame centroid Z at observation time.

causal_world_displacement_m.description: Causal Euclidean displacement between first valid detection and current detection up to timestamp t_i. Null if world pose/depth is invalid.

causal_path_length_m.description: Sum of consecutive world-space centroid step distances up to timestamp t_i. Null if world position is invalid.

causal_centroid_dispersion_m.description: Prefix-only spatial spread (std dev of world centroids around prefix mean) up to timestamp t_i. Null if world position is invalid.

world_position_valid.description: Whether ego-motion and 3D world centroid are valid at this observation timestamp.

causal_elapsed_sec.description: Elapsed time in seconds from first detection of this track up to timestamp t_i.

causal_observation_count.description: Number of detections of this track observed up to and including observation i.

apparent_camera_frame_displacement_m.description: Apparent displacement in camera frame — NOT ego-compensated. Can be large even for stationary objects due to camera motion.

camera_ego_motion_displacement_m.description: How much the camera moved during the track lifetime (ego-motion magnitude).

pipeline_motion_label.description: Pipeline's empirical motion classification over the full track.

track_obs_index.description: Index of this observation within the VLM sample (0=earliest, 4=latest).

track_obs_frac.description: Fractional position in track (0=first VLM obs, 1=last VLM obs).

lifespan_sec.description: Total track lifespan in seconds (first to last detection).

total_detections.description: Total YOLO detections for this track across all processed frames.

timestamp_rel.description: Observation timestamp relative to track start (seconds).

gt_vlm_label.description: Ground-truth VLM label from track_annotations.csv (None if UNCERTAIN).

annotation_confidence.description: Annotator confidence in the GT label.

evaluation_split.description: Which evaluation split partition this track belongs to.
